limitation: Ten hand-authored synthetic cases, one run per case; neither a general accuracy estimate nor a production benchmark.

groups.baseline: Security baseline. Scope: employees accessing sensitive production systems. Employees must complete security training within 30 days after first sensitive production-system access. No exceptions apply.
groups.replacement: Security replacement. Scope: employees accessing sensitive production systems. Employees must complete security training before any sensitive production-system access is granted. No exceptions apply.

cases.procedure: HR procedure. Scope: employees accessing sensitive production systems. HR must grant sensitive production-system access on day one even when employees have not completed security training. Employees may finish training within 30 days after access. No exceptions apply.
cases.reason: Explicit access before training conflicts in the same scope.

cases.procedure: HR procedure. Scope: employees accessing sensitive production systems. HR must withhold all sensitive production-system access until security training is complete. No exceptions apply.
cases.reason: The access gate satisfies the replacement policy.

cases.procedure: HR sandbox procedure. Scope: employees using only a non-sensitive demonstration sandbox with no connection or permission to production systems. HR must grant sandbox access before security training. This procedure never grants sensitive production-system access.
cases.reason: Only non-sensitive sandbox access is granted; the policy applies to sensitive production access.

cases.procedure: IT procedure. Scope: employees accessing sensitive production systems. IT must permit employees to use sensitive production systems for a seven-day grace period before security training is complete. No exceptions apply.
cases.reason: An explicit untrained grace period violates the access prerequisite.

groups.baseline: Security baseline. Scope: employees accessing sensitive production systems. Employees must complete security training within 30 days after first sensitive production-system access.
groups.replacement: Security replacement. Scope: employees accessing sensitive production systems. Employees must complete security training before sensitive production-system access, except designated emergency responders during a declared incident, who may complete training within 24 hours after emergency access. This is the only exception.

cases.procedure: Emergency HR procedure. Scope: designated employee emergency responders only during a declared incident. HR may grant emergency sensitive production-system access before security training; responders must complete training within 24 hours after that access. No other access is granted by this procedure.
cases.reason: Actor, condition and deadline match the explicit exception.

cases.procedure: Routine HR procedure. Scope: designated employee emergency responders on routine working days with no declared incident. HR must grant sensitive production-system access before security training and allow training within 24 hours after access.
cases.reason: The emergency exception cannot apply without a declared incident.

cases.procedure: HR procedure. Scope: all employees including emergency responders in every situation. HR must withhold sensitive production-system access until security training is complete, including during declared incidents.
cases.reason: A permitted exception need not be used; the stricter gate is compatible.

cases.procedure: Complete routine employee sensitive production-system onboarding procedure; no declared incidents are covered. HR must verify the employee's identity before provisioning sensitive production-system access. This is the entire selected procedure. It specifies no security-training prerequisite, deadline or exception and no other onboarding requirement.
cases.reason: A fully supplied procedure lacks the policy's training gate; absence is limited to this selected scope.
